scope: Five related analyst observations from one selected three-page intake/lead unit; not five witnesses, confirmed calls or independent corroborations.

observations.source_report: A masked recipient reportedly received an in-flight message from the named person, described as a passenger on Flight77; the record says the message was saved.
observations.distinction: This is an intake allegation in a reproduced FBI-form record. No original message, actual caller/flight identity, relationship to recipient, handset, call time or original media is established. The name is retained as printed, not spelling-corrected or matched to a passenger list.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original source interview/intake, recording/device/copy and creation/preservation metadata, custody receipt, actual lead response/disposition and applicable carrier/session identification.

literal_source_values.requested_action: CONTACT [masked] REGARDING CONTENTS OF MESSAGE ON ANSWERING MACHINE.

observations.distinction: The displayed task concerns contact about contents, not an explicit order to obtain a recording. Assignment is not completed contact, media collection, authentication or a result. No outcome appears within the inspected three-page unit; no case-wide absence claimed.
observations.missing_discriminator: Actual lead-response/FD302/contact and completion/closure records, dispatched/received versions, any recording submission, evidence inventory, laboratory/media review or finding including contrary/inconclusive results.

observations.kind: Date fields have distinct unverified event roles

pins.passage: Header date and Information Received fields

observations.distinction: The7:49PMlabel is an information-receipt field, not a time the reported message was left. No timezone, native event/creation/edit clock, elapsed processing interval or current case status is authenticated. Preserve all labels without changing one to make the chronology fit.
observations.missing_discriminator: Native ICF create/edit/export and assignment/transmission audit history, original tip/contact metadata and actual message timestamps with clock definitions.

observations.kind: Typed control versus unverified handwritten notation

pins.passage: Synopsis/control fields and handwritten bottom notation

observations.distinction: WF334is typed on the intake and assignment pages. The handwritten notation is read asWF8406, but its author/date/function and any alias/renumbering relationship are unknown. They are not counted as two independent leads. PENDINGis a printed record label, not a verified2026status.
observations.missing_discriminator: Original lead inventory/alias/cross-reference/history and copy/version provenance. Preserve both appearances without selecting or authenticating a mapping.

observations.kind: Potential call-canvass check with unverified relevance

comparison.scope: Previously inspected final-report note, reused context, not a new source acquisition or complete native family canvass.
comparison.prior_account: FBI/DOJ attribution of four unknown connected records to the Olson office rests in part on the account that family canvassing identified May parents and Ted Olson as recipients.

observations.distinction: An unresolved intake allegation does not establish another genuine Flight77call or refute the canvass. It identifies a particular lead whose verification/disposition can be checked. It cannot be assigned to an unknown row, device or session by name/flight wording alone.
observations.missing_discriminator: Actual message and lead disposition, identity/date/flight/channel evidence, full canvass scope and inclusion rules, native carrier/operator/recipient-office and source-to-exhibit joins. Inaccurate or unrelated tip, misattributed/earlier message, inconclusive follow-up and a genuine additional message remain untested alternatives.
